record.question: Answer the following: (a) The cost of 10 m of cloth is Rs.850, find the cost of 12 m of cloth. (10×1=10) (b) Write the degree of the polynomial 5 x 6 − y 3 + 5 xy 7 . (c) What percentage of Rs. 2.50 is 20 paise? (d) 2 of a number is 30. What is the number? 3 (e) What is the median of 10, 13, 22, 25, 8, 11, 19, 18, 31 and 16? (f) The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 4 and their HCF is 4, find their LCM. (g) What is the least number to be multiplied with 294 to make it a perfect square? (h) The average of 2, 7, 6 and x is 5 and the average of 18, 1, 6, x and y is 10. What is the value of y? (i) If 2 2 n −1 = 1 8 n −3 , then what is the value of n ? (j) A is younger than B by 4 years. If their ages are in the ratio of 7 : 9, how old is A?
record.direction: Written question — follow the original paper instructions. No MCQ answer index applies.
